preconditions.description: The number of names n must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(name) <= 100 for name in names)
preconditions.description: Each name must have a length between 1 and 100.
All names must contain only lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output must either be 'Impossible' or a permutation of all 26 lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: all(any(name[i] < name[i+1] for i in range(len(name)-1)) for name in names)
postconditions.description: If a valid order exists, the names must be sorted lexicographically according to the modified alphabet.
